# fall-kit

> Fall Kit v3.1.0: one script that gives any web page an AI helper the person controls (off, WebLLM in the browser, or their own key straight to the provider; keys held in the tab), with recycling of the opening, and the home of the Lego socket (kard.v1) every estate build carries. MIT.

## Canonical URL

https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fall-kit/

## Files

- fall-kit.js: the kit (FallKit global): aiComplete, aiChat, askPage, pageOpening, aiImage, aiVideo, aiTTS, aiSTT, lastUsage, forgetKeys, requestOf, textOf, usageOf, init, openSettings, meshStart, meshPost, helpSection
- socket.mjs: the five studs (brain, manifest, mesh, memory, proof); studsOf, present, kardOf, checkKard, kardText
- kard-writer.mjs: writes a build's kard.json from its files; --check for CI (with no --name, re-measures against the existing kard.json)
- socket-watch.mjs: clones all 100 builds and re-measures each against its kard.json (daily workflow)
- recycle.mjs: talkCost and teamCost at published rates (default Claude Opus 5.5)
- socket-builds.json: the 100 builds that carry the socket
- porter.mjs: inlines the kit into a build; shim.js: one-line loader
- kard.json: this repo's own kard
